children: CelcomDigi's recent share price weakness is likely to offer an attractive risk-reward opportunity, as expanding post-integration synergies are expected to drive a stronger earnings rebound, RHB IB analyst Jeffrey Tan says in a note. Cost savings are expected to increase in 2H and 2027, supporting an expected core earnings growth of 10% in 2027 and 19% in 2028, he reckons. The completion of Malaysia's state-backed 5G infrastructure firm Digital Nasional's 5.2 billion-ringgit debt restructuring also reduces the need for further shareholder funding, while network optimization could improve efficiency, he adds. RHB maintains a buy rating on CelcomDigi and keeps its target price at 3.70 ringgit. Shares are 1.2% lower at 2.48 ringgit. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
